name: publication_catalogs
description: Each catalog a protocol 2 publication copies, with the price sequence its copy includes; a price change finds the programs whose latest publication copies its catalog here.
lifecycle: Inserted with its publication; never updated. Deleted with the publication or the catalog.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the publication; immutable (tenant key).
The catalog's price sequence when it was copied: the copy includes every price change up to it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The catalog belongs to the same company; rows go with it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, publication_id) REFERENCES publications(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The publication belongs to the same company; rows go with it.
One row per catalog and publication.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX publication_catalogs_catalog_idx ON public.publication_catalogs USING btree (company_id, catalog_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds the publications that copy a catalog.
